plan: A troll who steals his enemies' strength and blocks their escape with an ice pillar.
aSurveiller: His R (Subjugate). He steals your health and resistances: facing him after that, you become much more fragile.
contrer: Walk around his pillar (E): it blocks the way and slows.
Don't fight on his ice zone (W): he gets stronger there.
Back off after his R: he has stolen your resistances.

sorts.P: Heals when an enemy dies near him.
sorts.Q: Bite that slows and steals damage.
sorts.R: Steals an enemy's health and resistances.

momentFort: Strong in the early and mid game.
